metadata.question: Does the surface water extent in Lake Sambhar, India decrease in around April 10, 2019 compared to around September 30, 2018?

data.raw_code:
<thinking>
1. Search strategy: Use Sentinel-2 SR (S2_SR_HARMONIZED) within a 30-day window around 2018-09-30 and 2019-04-10 over a rectangle covering Sambhar Lake (approx 26.8–27.1N, 75.0–75.4E). If no images, widen to 60 days; if still none, fallback to Landsat 8 L2. 
2. Masking strategy: Cloud-mask S2 using QA60 (bits 10/11), Landsat using QA_PIXEL (cloud/shadow). Compute MNDWI from Green and SWIR1. Water = MNDWI > 0.2 on median composites. 
3. Valid Zero vs Null: Check collection sizes; if zero after attempts → C1. Compute valid pixel counts at 1000 m; if zero → C2. If area returns null/NaN → C3. Otherwise compare water area km²: April vs September; if April < September → A, else B.
</thinking>

<code>
```javascript
const ee = require('@google/earthengine');
const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7');

async function runAnalysis() {
  try {
    // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions
    const geom = ee.Geometry.Rectangle([75.0, 26.8, 75.4, 27.1]); // Sambhar Lake, India
    const center1 = ee.Date('2018-09-30'); // around September 30, 2018
    const center2 = ee.Date('2019-04-10'); // around April 10, 2019
    const initWindow = 30; // days
    const wideWindow = 60;
    const scale = 1000; // per instructions (>=1000)

    // 2. Helper functions
    function s2Col(start, end) {
      const maskS2 = function(img) {
        const qa = img.select('QA60');
        const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 10).eq(0).and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 11).eq(0));
        return img.updateMask(mask);
      };
      const addMNDWI = function(img) {
        const g = img.select('B3').divide(10000);
        const swir = img.select('B11').divide(10000);
        const mndwi = g.subtract(swir).divide(g.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI');
        return img.addBands(mndwi);
      };
      return ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .map(maskS2)
        .map(addMNDWI)
        .select('MNDWI');
    }

    function l8Col(start, end) {
      const maskL8 = function(img) {
        const qa = img.select('QA_PIXEL');
        const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 3).eq(0) // cloud
          .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(1 << 4).eq(0)); // cloud shadow
        return img.updateMask(mask);
      };
      const addMNDWI = function(img) {
        const g = img.select('SR_B3').multiply(2.75e-5).add(-0.2);
        const swir = img.select('SR_B6').multiply(2.75e-5).add(-0.2);
        const mndwi = g.subtract(swir).divide(g.add(swir)).rename('MNDWI');
        return img.addBands(mndwi);
      };
      return ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2')
        .filterBounds(geom)
        .filterDate(start, end)
        .map(maskL8)
        .map(addMNDWI)
        .select('MNDWI');
    }

    async function getCompositeStats(centerDate, label) {
      // Try S2 with 30d window
      let start = centerDate.advance(-initWindow, 'day');
      let end = centerDate.advance(initWindow, 'day');
      let col = s2Col(start, end);
      let sensor = 'S2';
      let size = await col.size().getInfo();
      if (size === 0) {
        // widen S2
        start = centerDate.advance(-wideWindow, 'day');
        end = centerDate.advance(wideWindow, 'day');
        col = s2Col(start, end);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        // fallback to Landsat 8 with 30d then 60d
        sensor = 'L8';
        start = centerDate.advance(-initWindow, 'day');
        end = centerDate.advance(initWindow, 'day');
        col = l8Col(start, end);
        size = await col.size().getInfo();
        if (size === 0) {
          start = centerDate.advance(-wideWindow, 'day');
          end = centerDate.advance(wideWindow, 'day');
          col = l8Col(start, end);
          size = await col.size().getInfo();
        }
      }
      if (size === 0) {
        return {status: 'C1', label, details: `${label} Images: 0`};
      }

      // Median composite of MNDWI
      const comp = col.median().select('MNDWI');
      // Valid pixel count and total pixel count at scale
      const validDict = ee.Dictionary({
        validCount: comp.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('MNDWI'),
        totalCount: ee.Image(1).rename('ones').reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.count(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('ones')
      });
      const validInfo = await validDict.getInfo();
      const validCount = validInfo.validCount || 0;
      const totalCount = validInfo.totalCount || 0;
      if (validCount === 0) {
        return {status: 'C2', label, details: `${label} ValidPx: 0`};
      }
      const cloudFrac = totalCount > 0 ? Math.max(0, Math.min(1, 1 - (validCount / totalCount))) : null;

      // Water area using threshold
      const thresh = 0.2;
      const waterMask = comp.gt(thresh).selfMask();
      const areaImg = ee.Image.pixelArea().updateMask(waterMask).rename('area');
      const areaDict = ee.Dictionary({
        waterAreaM2: areaImg.reduceRegion({
          reducer: ee.Reducer.sum(),
          geometry: geom,
          scale: scale,
          maxPixels: 1e9
        }).get('area')
      });
      const areaInfo = await areaDict.getInfo();
      const waterAreaM2 = areaInfo.waterAreaM2;
      if (waterAreaM2 === null || waterAreaM2 === undefined || isNaN(waterAreaM2)) {
        return {status: 'C3', label, details: `${label} Area calc failed`};
      }
      const waterKm2 = waterAreaM2 / 1e6;

      return {
        status: 'OK',
        label,
        sensor,
        windowDays: end.difference(start, 'day').getInfo(),
        imgCount: size,
        validCount,
        cloudFrac,
        waterKm2,
        thresh
      };
    }

    // 3. Processing and stats
    const s1 = await getCompositeStats(center1, '2018-09-30');
    const s2 = await getCompositeStats(center2, '2019-04-10');

    // 4. Handle failure cases
    if (s1.status !== 'OK' || s2.status !== 'OK') {
      // Print concise reasons
      if (s1.status !== 'OK') console.log(s1.details || `${s1.label} Status: ${s1.status}`);
      if (s2.status !== 'OK') console.log(s2.details || `${s2.label} Status: ${s2.status}`);
      const finalTag = (s1.status === 'C1' || s2.status === 'C1') ? 'C1'
        : (s1.status === 'C2' || s2.status === 'C2') ? 'C2'
        : (s1.status === 'C3' || s2.status === 'C3') ? 'C3'
        : 'D';
      console.log(finalTag);
      return;
    }

    // 5. Validation & Final Answer
    const lines = [];
    lines.push(`${s1.label} ±${Math.round(s1.windowDays/2)}d | ${s1.sensor} | Images: ${s1.imgCount} | ValidPx: ${s1.validCount} | CloudFrac: ${s1.cloudFrac !== null ? s1.cloudFrac.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    lines.push(`Water km2: ${s1.waterKm2.toFixed(2)} | Thresh: ${s1.thresh}`);
    lines.push(`${s2.label} ±${Math.round(s2.windowDays/2)}d | ${s2.sensor} | Images: ${s2.imgCount} | ValidPx: ${s2.validCount} | CloudFrac: ${s2.cloudFrac !== null ? s2.cloudFrac.toFixed(2) : 'NA'}`);
    lines.push(`Water km2: ${s2.waterKm2.toFixed(2)} | Thresh: ${s2.thresh}`);

    const diff = s2.waterKm2 - s1.waterKm2;
    const changePct = s1.waterKm2 > 0 ? (diff / s1.waterKm2) * 100 : null;
    lines.push(`Diff km2 (Apr - Sep): ${diff.toFixed(2)} | Change: ${changePct !== null ? changePct.toFixed(1) + '%' : 'NA'}`);

    // Print evidence (<=20 lines)
    for (const l of lines) console.log(l);

    // Decision
    if (!isFinite(diff)) {
      console.log('C3');
      return;
    }
    const answerTag = diff < 0 ? 'A: Yes' : 'B: No';
    console.log(answerTag);
  } catch (err) {
    console.log('D');
  }
}

async function initEE() {
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject);
  });
  await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
    ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject);
  });
  await runAnalysis();
}

initEE();
```
